══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  MiraSight — YOLO26 Model Files
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Place your YOLO26 ONNX models here before running
`npm run build`. They will be served at /models/<name>.onnx
with a 1-year immutable cache header on Netlify.

REQUIRED EXPORT FORMAT — end-to-end (NMS built-in):
────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  from ultralytics import YOLO

  # Detection
  model = YOLO("yolo26n.pt")
  model.export(format="onnx", imgsz=640, end2end=True)

  # Segmentation
  model = YOLO("yolo26n-seg.pt")
  model.export(format="onnx", imgsz=640, end2end=True)

  # Pose
  model = YOLO("yolo26n-pose.pt")
  model.export(format="onnx", imgsz=640, end2end=True)

OUTPUT TENSOR FORMAT (YOLO26 end-to-end):
────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Shape: [1, max_detections, 6]
  Row:   [x1, y1, x2, y2, confidence, class_id]
  Coords: pixel space relative to model input size
  NMS:   built into the model — no JS NMS needed

ALTERNATIVE — upload directly via the app UI:
────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Use the model drop zone in the sidebar.
  No rebuild needed; large files stay out of git.

FILES EXPECTED HERE (examples):
────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  yolo26n.onnx          <- detection (nano)
  yolo26n-seg.onnx      <- segmentation (nano)
  yolo26n-pose.onnx     <- pose estimation (nano)
  your_custom.onnx      <- any YOLO26 end2end export
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
